calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Cooling
calculators.description: The time a blown or rotomolded wall takes to cool from the melt to its eject temperature (Menges, as the plastic molding cooling calculator): t = s² / (π² α) × ln(4/π × (Tm − Tw) / (Te − Tw)), α = k / (ρ_melt × cp). The shell is cooled from the mold side only (air inside), so s is twice the wall (eMithran assumption). The material's melt temperature, mold temperature, eject deflection temperature, melt density, specific heat and thermal conductivity of the melt are memory/Roto & blow molding's (raw_material_properties).

source.engine: wall_mm (twice the shell's nominal wall: cooled from one side)

fields.name: Cooling Time
fields.formula: {Wall} * {Wall} / (pi * pi * {Thermal Diffusivity}) * LN(4 / pi * ({Melt Temperature} - {Mold Temperature}) / ({Eject Temperature} - {Mold Temperature}))

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Inflate
calculators.description: The time a blow mold takes to fill the parison with air: the part's inside volume through the blow pin's bore (boreDiameter) at the air's speed (airFlowVelocity).

fields.name: Inflate Time
fields.formula: {Inside Volume} / ({Air Flow Velocity} * 1000 * pi * {Bore Diameter} * {Bore Diameter} / 4)

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Blow mold cavities
calculators.description: How many parts one blow mold makes a shot: the cavities the mold's length takes in a row (each the part's length and the adjacent cavity margin, never closer than the parisons' centre distance, the mold's own envelope margin at both ends), capped by the parisons the head extrudes; none when the part, with the envelope margin each side, is wider than the mold, or deeper than its two halves.

source.engine: part_length_mm (the envelope across the parting plane, long side)
part_width_mm (the envelope across the parting plane, short side)

fields.name: Cavities
fields.formula: {Fits Across} * {Fits Deep} * min({Max Parisons}, max(0, floor(({Mold Length} - 2 * {Envelope Margin} + {Adjacent Margin}) / max({Part Length} + {Adjacent Margin}, {Parison Distance}))))

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Extrusion blow mold
calculators.description: Extrusion blow molding, per part. A shot is the machine's dry cycle (the mold closing on the parison, the shuttle), the inflation and the wall's cooling (times blowMoldVacuumFactor when the mold pulls a vacuum for in-mold labels); it makes one part per cavity, at each station.

source.engine: cavities (Roto & Blow Molding - Blow mold cavities)

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Molds per arm
calculators.description: How many molds one carousel arm carries. A mold is the part grown by its shrinkage (rotoMoldingShrinkageAllowance, %) with the flange and framework (rotoMoldStructureMargin) on each side; it must swing within the machine's cylinder with the mounting margin (rotoMoldMountingMargin); the molds that fit side by side on a mounting surface (rotoMoldSpacingMargin between them), times the arm's mounting surfaces, as many as the weight capacity carries of the charges (the molds' own weight is not known: the charge only).

fields.name: Per Surface
fields.formula: max({Mold Length}, {Mold Depth}) <= {Usable} ? floor(({Usable} + {Spacing Margin}) / ({Mold Length} + {Spacing Margin})) * floor(({Usable} + {Spacing Margin}) / ({Mold Width} + {Spacing Margin})) : 0

fields.name: Molds per Arm
fields.formula: min({Per Surface} * {Surfaces per Arm}, floor({Weight Capacity} / max({Charge Mass}, 0.001)))

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Load and unload
calculators.description: The load station's work on one arm, per mold: clean the mold and spray its release over its surface (rotoMoldCleanRate, applyMoldReleaseRate: memory gives them without a unit; read as mm² a second, 1 ft² and 4 ft² a second, which puts a mold's whole load and unload at about a minute), fill it (moldFillRate), open and close its clamps (as many as its parting line takes at clampSpacing, never fewer than minNumberOfClamps; clampingRate each way), take out and put back its cores (coreInstallRate each way), place its inserts (insertInstallRate) and labels (applyLabelRate), and trim the cut-outs by hand at manualTrimRate.

source.engine: clamps (the parting line at clampSpacing, at least minNumberOfClamps)

fields.name: Per Mold
fields.formula: {Mold Area} / {Clean Rate} + {Mold Area} / {Release Rate} + {Fill Time} + {Clamps} * {Clamping Time} * 2 + {Cores} * {Core Time} * 2 + {Inserts} * {Insert Time} + {Labels} * {Label Time} + {Trim Length} / {Trim Rate}

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Rotational mold
calculators.description: Rotational molding on a carousel, per part. Its arms pass in turn through the oven, the cooling station and the load station: the carousel indexes when the slowest of the three is done, plus its index time, and each index completes one arm's molds. The oven time is taken as the cooling time (eMithran assumption: memory/Roto & blow molding holds no oven temperature or heating rate) unless set in the Cost Guide (rotoOvenTimeS).

source.engine: oven_time_s (the cooling time, or the Cost Guide's)
load_time_s (Roto & Blow Molding - Load and unload)
molds_per_arm (Roto & Blow Molding - Molds per arm)

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Grind
calculators.description: Grinding the pellets to the powder a rotational mold is charged with (grindProcessEnable), per part: the charge at the grinder's rate.

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Router
calculators.description: Routing a molded part, per part: the parting line's pinch-off and the openings cut after molding, at the router's feed rate, a rapid move to each cut (the part's diagonal at the rapid traverse rate), and the part's handling (materialHandling by its weight).

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Cut Length} / {Feed Rate} * 60 + {Cuts} * {Part Diagonal} / {Rapid Rate} * 60 + {Handling Time}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Saw
calculators.description: Sawing a blown part's neck moil off, per part: the sawn section at the circular saw's cutting rate (circularSawCutting), and the part's handling (materialHandling by its weight).

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Blow molded material
calculators.description: The resin one blown part takes: the part and the pinch-off flash along its parting line (blowMoldTailLength long, the wall thick), times the flash dial (materialVolumeComp), at the material's density and price, plus colorant (colorantCost a kg) when the part is colored and its in-mold labels (defaultCostPerBlowMoldLabel each).

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Rotomolded material
calculators.description: The powder one rotomolded part takes: the part, and the plugs cut out of its openings with their trim stock (trimStockAllowance), times the volume dial (materialVolumeComp), at the material's density and price, plus colorant (colorantCost a kg) when colored, its inserts (defaultInsertCost each) and in-mold labels (defaultCostPerLabel each).

source.engine: trim_waste_mm3 (the cut-out plugs and their stock)

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Blow mold tooling
calculators.description: The blow mold's cost, from its size (eMithran assumption: memory/Roto & blow molding gives only its limits, blowMoldingMinMoldCost to blowMoldingMaxMoldCost, and its dial blowMoldingMoldCostComp): the limit range scaled by the cavities' area over the largest blow mold platen, never above the upper limit, times the dial and the region's multiplier (regionMultiplier).

source.engine: size (the cavities' area on the platen: each the part with the envelope margin, mm²)
largest (the same measure of the largest machine)

fields.name: Tool Cost
fields.formula: ({Minimum Cost} + ({Maximum Cost} - {Minimum Cost}) * {Size Share}) * {Cost Dial} * {Region Multiplier}

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Trim tooling
calculators.description: The trim-transfer tooling's cost, from its size (eMithran assumption: memory/Roto & blow molding gives only its limits, blowMoldingMinTrimToolingCost to blowMoldingMaxTrimToolingCost, and its dial blowMoldingTrimToolingCostComp): the limit range scaled by the routed length over the largest blow mold platen's perimeter, never above the upper limit, times the dial and the region's multiplier (regionMultiplier).

source.engine: largest (the same measure of the largest machine)

fields.name: Tool Cost
fields.formula: ({Minimum Cost} + ({Maximum Cost} - {Minimum Cost}) * {Size Share}) * {Cost Dial} * {Region Multiplier}

calculators.name: Roto & Blow Molding - Rotational mold tooling
calculators.description: The rotational mold's cost, from its size (eMithran assumption: memory/Roto & blow molding gives only its limits, rotoMoldingMinMoldCost to rotoMoldingMaxMoldCost, and its dial rotoMoldingMoldCostComp): the limit range scaled by the mold's surface over the surface of the largest mold the largest carousel swings, never above the upper limit, times the dial and the region's multiplier (regionMultiplier).

source.engine: largest (the same measure of the largest machine)

fields.name: Tool Cost
fields.formula: ({Minimum Cost} + ({Maximum Cost} - {Minimum Cost}) * {Size Share}) * {Cost Dial} * {Region Multiplier}
